yt_description:
Ever wondered how data gets sorted with a bit of flair? 🤔 Meet Cocktail Sort, also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort! We're visualizing this quirky algorithm step-by-step, making complex sorting logic easy to grasp. Watch as it shuffles back and forth like a perfectly crafted cocktail! 🍹

In this video, you'll learn:

✅ The core concept of Cocktail Sort
✅ How it differs from simple Bubble Sort
✅ A clear, visual breakdown of its execution
✅ When this algorithm might (or might not!) be your go-to choice

Perfect for students, developers, and anyone curious about the magic behind sorting algorithms! ✨ Don't forget to LIKE, SUBSCRIBE, and hit the BELL for more algorithmic adventures! 🚀
